## The tools your agent gets

Reading research back is free, so your agent can return to the same search as often as it needs.

### search

Searches the web for UGC on Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook, reads the comments, and returns a cited answer with the top quotes. Paste a post or video link to read its comments. Uses credits.

### get_quotes

Pages through every quote, filtered by pain point, failed solution, objection, desired outcome, lingo, source, or phrase. Free.

### get_comments

Hands back the raw comment bodies, grouped by thread or video. Free.

### get_sources

Lists the threads and videos read, with engagement and quote counts. Free.

### ask

Asks a follow-up over research you already ran, without searching again. Uses credits for the answer only.

### generate_hooks

Writes ad hooks from the quotes, in your customers' own words. Uses credits for the hooks only.

### get_search

Reads back a finished search, or resumes one still running. Free.

### list_searches

Finds research you ran before, in the app or through the API. Free.

### get_balance

Checks your credit balance. Free.

## Questions

### What is the BuzzSearch MCP server?

A remote MCP server that lets an AI agent search Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook comments and pull back exact customer quotes. Your agent calls it the way it calls any other tool.

### Which AI clients does it work with?

Any client that supports remote MCP servers over HTTP, including Claude Code, Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, and Grok Build.

### Do I need an API key?

No. Most clients open a BuzzSearch sign-in the first time you connect. For headless agents, create a key in Settings and send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

### How much does it cost?

A search uses credits from your BuzzSearch balance. Reading back a finished search, its quotes, its sources, and its comments is free, so your agent can come back to the same research as often as it needs. See pricing

### What does it return?

A cited answer, verbatim quotes tagged by pain point, failed solution, objection, desired outcome, and lingo, the threads and videos behind them, and the raw comments if you want them. Every quote links back to where it was written.

### Can I use research from the BuzzSearch app?

Yes. list_searches shows research you ran in the app too, and your agent can read its quotes and comments without paying for the search twice.
